amendment_01.cause: An unconditional if_push with scope_kind == 0x01 masks off the only lane of a one-thread dispatch, in BOTH mask banks; scope_kind == 0x1a does not.
amendment_01.hash_note: harness/isa_helpers.py and harness/cases.py changed, so their hashes here are the AMENDED ones. A capture is valid against the hashes recorded for its own run in raw/<run>/00_env.json.
amendment_01.retained: raw/g17p_20260830_run01 is retained in full and never reused; its C2 half is excluded from every verdict, its C1 half is an earlier third observation.
amendment_01.what: The frozen `C2 nested` carrier (if_push scope=0x54 kind=0x01) was MEASURED DEAD: all 1395 of its run01 cases wrote the PRE sentinel and nothing else -- all 16 registers, the POST sentinel and the callee breadcrumb still 0xDEADBEEF, status OK, tail intact. Replaced by if_push(scope=0x56, scope_kind=0x1a).

clean_room.declared_boundary: Apple's inlining heuristic is a DECLARED CLEAN-ROOM BOUNDARY (docs/P0-P1-CLOSURE.md P0.8) and is NOT characterised. The census authors OUR OWN MSL until the instruction appears and reports per-construct outcomes only -- no threshold, no interpolation, no claim about why anything inlined, and no Apple binary inspected.
clean_room.instruction_under_test: GENERATED from the pinned db.json's declared bit geometry by isa_helpers.call_bytes()/ret_bytes(); ZERO bytes copied from any compiled shader. Arm S additionally mutates a REAL compiler-emitted call inside OUR OWN compiled program, as an independent second method, labelled as such.

environment.baseline_use: The unmutated program is re-run periodically for RUN INTEGRITY only. NO case is scored against it -- every oracle is host-computed from isa_helpers.SEED_I and the frozen layout.
environment.poison: 0xDEADBEEF over all 104 output words before every dispatch
environment.seed_method: mov_imm immediates ONLY. device_load is FORBIDDEN on every verdict path (DEF-0169-1: device_load is ASYNCHRONOUS on G17P and fabricates movement); it appears only in arm O, where that asynchrony is the instrument and promotion is pre-declined.

gap: docs/P0-P1-CLOSURE.md P0.8 ranked blocker #2 (EXP-0177 analysis/p08_gaps.md G2): call.{b3,b5,b6,tail} are tokenization-only and ret.scoreboard was declined in advance, so NO CALL CAN BE EMITTED -- which blocks EXP-0137's split-epilog contract, every out-of-line helper, and non-leaf frames.

gate.carrier_dimension: execution-mask stack depth at the call (flat vs one if_push deep) -- the dimension H4 says these fields control. Two carriers differing only in the register plan would be ONE carrier.

observable.breadcrumb: W_CALLEE -- a store made INSIDE the callee, so 'ran but never returned' survives a caller-side dump that never executes
observable.dump: 16 GPR stores in a FIXED order, byte-identical in every case of every arm
observable.landing_ladder: 4 x 2-byte mov_imm rungs before the callee entry; the lowest rung that fired localises a mis-targeted branch to 2 bytes
observable.rule_3a: STRUCTURAL, not careful: neither `call` nor `ret` declares a register-typed field, so no swept value can name the read-back index register, any store's data register, the sentinel registers, or the callee register.
observable.sentinels: PRE (written before the call) and POST (written after it returns)
observable.tail_poison: 28 words never stored to; any change is invalid_sentinel
